name: 70663 · Sulphur, LA
findings: ZIP 70663 (Sulphur) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70663 (Sulphur) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70663 (Sulphur) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).
